## About
Rotary Power has been repairing and building rotary motors for as long as they have been in production. We specialize in the attention to detail that is needed when rebuilding or servicing your rotary.
Our shop does machine work, porting, engine and turbo rebuilds, and transmission work. One reviewer praised the honesty and knowledge of Jeff and his nephew, and another said Jeff will tell you what you really need versus what you don't.
We're in Gardena, close to the freeways, and we hold a 4.8 Google rating from 27 reviews.

## Services
- Mild street port: A street port that passes smog. ($400)
- Race port: Porting for full power. ($500)
- Peripheral port ($900)
- 93-95 street ported engine: With new apex seals, corner seals, side seals, oil control rings, all springs, main seals and water seals, using your good core. ($3595)
- Twin turbo rebuild: Rebuild using your good core. ($950)
- Turbo installation: Installation plus gaskets. ($550)
- Transmission rebuild: Rebuild with a gear upgrade. ($1195)

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open 10 to 6, Monday through Friday. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I email a question instead of calling?
A: Yes. Send us your question and we will try to get back to you as soon as possible.
